Applying for a China visa? Don’t let a simple photo mistake delay your plans. Your visa photo must meet strict guidelines to ensure smooth processing.

The required China visa photo size is 33mm x 48mm, with your face covering 70–80% of the frame. Your head height should be between 28mm and 33mm, properly centered and clearly visible. Make sure the photo is taken within the last 6 months and reflects your current appearance without any edits or filters.

Keep a neutral expression while looking straight at the camera. Avoid smiling, tilting your head, or wearing glasses and non-religious headwear. The background must be plain white, free from shadows, patterns, or any distractions.

Following these China visa photo requirements carefully can help you avoid rejections and ensure a faster, hassle-free visa process.

They may be good with specific UK and Ireland universities, maybe a few in the US (probably the ones that have a high acceptance rate). But if your aim is to apply to some top high ranking universities, I am sorry but Global Opportunities would be the worst choice.

My review is localised to the Dadar branch based on my experience. I hope branches in some other states would be somewhat credible. GO dadar is not.
